noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

designable.description:
Indicates whether this component is configurable in UI Designer.
If set to `true`, the component will appear in the UI Designer menu of available components.

attributes.description:
Attributes of this component.  Different from category in that there may be multiple,
and they are only used internally so they do not need to be translated.

category.description:
The translation key of the component category name. This allows for components to be grouped
into categories in the UI Designer menu of available components.

name.description: The translation key of the human-readable name of this component.

icon.description: The icon name of this component.

name: Ann.UiSdlDesignerComponent
